title: Product Finish-Date and Repurchase
dataSources: Wardrobe items (`wardrobe:item`), outfit wears (`outfit:wear`), skincare routines (`skincare:routine`), laundry cycles (`laundry:cycle`).
app: Wardrobe and grooming logs — closet apps (Whering, Stylebook), cost-per-wear trackers, skincare-routine logs, and smart-laundry cycles — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=skincare:routine event=product
| eval daily_use=amount_per_use*uses_per_day, days_left=round(remaining_ml/daily_use,0)
| where days_left<14
| sort days_left
description: Predicts when your skincare and beauty products will run out so you repurchase before hitting empty.
value: Running out of a daily product mid-routine is annoying; a finish-date forecast keeps essentials stocked.
implementation: Ingest product usage into `index=personal`; predict finish dates.
visualization: Table of products by days until empty.
grandmaExplanation: It predicts when your skincare products will run out, so you can restock before they do.
